description: Implementation of QuicControlFrameManager class managing control frames in QUIC protocol, including buffering, retransmission, and acknowledgment handling.

classes.name: QuicControlFrameManager
classes.description: Manages control frames for QUIC, including buffering, retransmission, and acknowledgment.

methods.name: WriteOrBufferQuicFrame
methods.description: Adds a frame to buffer or writes it if possible.

methods.name: WriteOrBufferRstStream
methods.description: Buffers or writes a RST_STREAM frame.

methods.name: WriteOrBufferGoAway
methods.description: Buffers or writes a GOAWAY frame.

methods.name: WriteOrBufferWindowUpdate
methods.description: Buffers or writes a WINDOW_UPDATE frame.

methods.name: WriteOrBufferBlocked
methods.description: Buffers or writes a BLOCKED frame.

methods.name: WriteOrBufferStreamsBlocked
methods.description: Buffers or writes a STREAMS_BLOCKED frame.

methods.name: WriteOrBufferMaxStreams
methods.description: Buffers or writes a MAX_STREAMS frame.

methods.name: WriteOrBufferStopSending
methods.description: Buffers or writes a STOP_SENDING frame.

methods.name: WriteOrBufferHandshakeDone
methods.description: Buffers or writes a HANDSHAKE_DONE frame.

methods.name: WriteOrBufferAckFrequency
methods.description: Buffers or writes an ACK_FREQUENCY frame.

methods.name: WriteOrBufferNewConnectionId
methods.description: Buffers or writes a NEW_CONNECTION_ID frame.

methods.name: WriteOrBufferRetireConnectionId
methods.description: Buffers or writes a RETIRE_CONNECTION_ID frame.

methods.name: WriteOrBufferNewToken
methods.description: Buffers or writes a NEW_TOKEN frame.

methods.name: OnControlFrameSent
methods.description: Handles logic after a control frame is sent.

methods.name: OnControlFrameAcked
methods.description: Handles logic when a control frame is acknowledged.

methods.name: OnControlFrameLost
methods.description: Handles logic when a control frame is lost.

methods.name: IsControlFrameOutstanding
methods.description: Checks if a control frame is still outstanding.

methods.name: HasPendingRetransmission
methods.description: Checks if there are frames pending retransmission.

methods.name: WillingToWrite
methods.description: Indicates if the manager is willing to write frames.

methods.name: NextPendingRetransmission
methods.description: Returns the next frame pending retransmission.

methods.name: OnCanWrite
methods.description: Triggers writing of frames or retransmissions when possible.

methods.name: RetransmitControlFrame
methods.description: Retransmits a control frame if appropriate.

methods.name: WriteBufferedFrames
methods.description: Writes buffered frames.

methods.name: WritePendingRetransmission
methods.description: Writes frames pending retransmission.

methods.name: OnControlFrameIdAcked
methods.description: Handles acknowledgment of a control frame ID.
